raw_apply_gains — GFX2D isp op

• 数据种类:image2d × vector → image2d

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.raw_apply_gains(raw, gains, pattern='RGGB')(要直接调用实现,import gfx2d; gfx2d.raw_apply_gains(raw, gains, pattern='RGGB');从台账取用则 opsgfx2d.get("raw_apply_gains"))

用法

对 Bayer 帧逐通道乘以增益(去马赛克前的白平衡)。
